packageRules.description: HARD.06 G5 - major-bump quarantine. Majors are held on the Dependency Dashboard until a human approves them, are never automerged, and never ride inside a routine group PR.

The reusable workflows in PiersAG/app-business-core are called by uses: refs in this repo, but that repo is private and has no Renovate app install, so every lookup fails with no-result and surfaces as an error on the Dependency Dashboard. Nothing to update here - these refs are pinned by hand.
